base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a cosy circular kitchen-laboratory inside the lighthouse with curved copper walls, a mirror-polished salvage-metal table, a kettle, a ceiling fan, an armchair, half-finished gadgets everywhere, coiled cables, and a chaotic workbench. Lighting: warm morning light through round porthole windows.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; a beautifully plated grilled sea bass fillet beside a perfect scoop of pale-green mint-choc-chip ice cream on a gleaming plate.
Camera: Medium close-up over the plate.
Action: Tomkin plates his signature dish with fussy precision — grilled sea bass beside a perfect scoop of mint-choc-chip ice cream — and adds one final mint leaf with tweezers, eyes closed in bliss.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, reverent, savouring) says: "Grilled sea bass with mint-choc-chip. Perfection is a recipe, and I wrote it."
Sound effects: sizzle, plate clink, satisfied sigh, ambience of ticking gadgets, fridge hum, distant waves.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
